title: Find 10% first, then 5%
text: $$10\%$$ of a number is one tenth of it. $$5\%$$ is half of that 10%. Adding them gives 15%. A common mistake is to compute $$15 \times 60$$. What is $$10\%$$ of 60?

title: Add half of that for the extra 5%
text: Half of 6 is the extra $$5\%$$. What is $$6 + 3$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$15\%$$ of $$60 = 0.15 \times 60 = 9$$. Common mistake: answering $$900$$ or $$15$$. General rule: $$p\%$$ of $$n$$ is $$\frac{p}{100} \times n$$. Splitting the percent into 10% and 5% is a check, not a different rule.
